speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in. I understand you are experiencing rectal bleeding and have noticed a palpable mass in your rectum. To better understand your condition, how long have you been noticing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Carcinoma

Thank you for that information. Since you have a palpable mass and daily bleeding without pain, I need to confirm if you have any unintentional weight loss or a change in your bowel habits, such as narrower stools. I will also need to order a colonoscopy with biopsy to visualize the lesion and obtain a tissue diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Colonoscopy with biopsy.
